name: Human-Crafted UI Guardrails
principles: Real data states over perfect demo states
Original proprietary components over interchangeable template cards
forbidden_patterns: every section wrapped in a card
inventing brand colors or component styles per screen
required_review_questions: Could this screen belong to any random SaaS product?
Is there at least one product-specific design idea?
Does this reflect a real Nepal workforce scenario?
Would a worker understand it quickly?
Does it handle messy real-world data?
Has a human design review occurred before production?
